literal: Those who lack motivation will not attain in the world the pride called 'we are generous'.
translation: Those who lack inner motivation will never attain the proud joy of saying, 'We are generous,' in this world.
modern: ஊக்கம் இல்லாதவர்கள், 'நாங்கள் கொடைத்தன்மை உடையவர்கள்' என்று பெருமையோடு சொல்லிக்கொள்ளும் மகிழ்ச்சியை இவ்வுலகில் அடையமாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains that inner motivation or resolve (உள்ளம்) is the foundation for all great deeds, including philanthropy. Without this driving energy, a person cannot acquire the means or the spirit to help others. Consequently, they will never experience the righteous pride (செருக்கு) and joy that comes from being known as a generous benefactor (வள்ளியம்) in society. The poet uses 'செருக்கு' here not as negative arrogance, but as the healthy self-worth and elation born of noble giving.
